slug: 2026-02-02 Mali unveils modern Tier III data centre

facts.fact: The Malian government inaugurated its National Data Centre in Bamako around the weekend before 2 Feb 2026 (date is the article's publication date, no event date given); the ministry says it gives administrations, companies, start-ups and technical partners a hosting environment and will host mutualised AES infrastructure short term.
The Malian government describes the National Data Centre in Bamako as a Tier III facility (operator's own statement, no certification named); event date is the article's publication date.

systems.country_label: Centre de données national / National Data Centre
systems.owner: Government of Mali (Ministry of Communication, Digital Economy and Administrative Modernization)

note: Facts rest on the ministry's statement that companies and start-ups are served; state-owned, hire to outsiders only loosely stated
